'''The Dusty Wheel''' is an inn in [[Caemlyn]]. Though, its patrons, Nobles, commoners and everything in between know it as The Rumor Wheel. It is owned by Innkeeper [[Hatch]]. 

==Appearance==

The sign has a wagon wheel painted on it. The Inn's walls and it's fine windows are dark from years of smokes pipes inside it, and it's tradition to never clean them. 

==Activities==
[[Mat Cauthon]] is dicing at The Dusty Wheel before leaving to combat the [[Gholam]]. 

==Parallels==

The dark walls and pipe smoking are indicative of just how much its patrons share rumors and speculation about the goings on in the World and beyond. The inn is based on [http://Theoryland.com Theoryland of the Wheel of Time] and Innkeeper Hatch is a tribute to Matt Hatch, webmaster of the "hardcore fan freaks" at Theoryland.com. Matt Hatch also began a live, weekly, call-in Wheel of Time Talk Show on YouTube called [https://youtube.com/thedustywheel ''The Dusty Wheel''].
